intro: Delray Beach carries its history close to the coast, from early 20th century cottages near downtown to the newer construction that has filled in west of Interstate 95 over the past few decades. That mix means a service call here can turn up a decades-old fuse box a few blocks from the beach or a modern panel just a short drive inland. We run north into Palm Beach County regularly, and Delray Beach sits solidly on that route. Salt air off the ocean adds its own wear to older equipment near downtown, quietly working on connections that look fine from the outside. When breakers trip for no clear reason or a pool's bonding needs a look, you want a licensed crew that treats both the old and the new housing stock with the same care. We come out, look in person, and give you one honest price.
housingNotes: Delray Beach's oldest homes cluster near downtown and Old School Square, with cottages and bungalows dating to the early and mid 20th century, while much of the rest of the city filled in through the 1970s and 1980s, and newer development continues further west. That range means original fuse boxes and early breaker panels still show up close to the coast, alongside brands the industry no longer considers safe. Salt air off the Atlantic adds an extra factor for homes near downtown and the beach, corroding lugs and terminations faster than the same equipment would age inland. Pools are common across the city's neighborhoods, older and newer alike, so bonding and grounding deserve attention regardless of when the home was built. Newer construction west of the city is generally well protected. It is the historic and coastal pockets where an aging panel most often needs an honest look.

challenges.body: Homes close to downtown Delray Beach and the coastline sit in a steady stream of salt air, and it corrodes the lugs, bus bars, and terminations inside a panel and meter over time. A corroded connection runs hotter than it should. On a coastal call our crew pays close attention to every connection before pricing the work.
